description: This file contains assembly code for the LZMA compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards, including startup routines, cache management, and relocation logic.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point macro for board startup, including cache setup, relocation, clearing bss, and jumping to main loader.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: Assembly macro for executing an EHB (Execution Halt Barrier) instruction.
